title: Session 3: Regression coefficients and model matrices
text: model: $$ \begin{aligned} Logit(P(x)) &= log \left( \frac{P(x)}{1-P(x)} \right) \notag\\ &= \beta_0 + \beta_1 x_{1i} + \beta_2 x_{2i} + ... + \beta_p x_{pi} \notag \end{aligned} $$ Random component: yiy_i follows Binomial distribution (outcome binary variable) Systematic component: linear predictor β0+β1x1i+β2x2i+...+βpxpi \beta_0 + \beta_1 x_{1i} + \beta_2 x_{2i} + ... + \beta_p x_{pi} Link function: logit (log odds event occurs) g(P(x))=logit(P(x))=log(P(x)1−P(x)) g(P(x)) = logit(P(x)) = log\left( \frac{P(x)}{1-P(x)} \right) P(x)=g−1(β0+β1x1i+β2x2i+...+βpxpi) P(x) = g^{-1}\left( \beta_0 + \beta_1 x_{1i} + \beta_2 x_{2i} + ... + \beta_p x_{pi}  \right)

text: (Y1Y2⋮YN)=(1x11x2⋮1xN)(β0β1)+(ε1ε2⋮εN) \, \begin{pmatrix} Y_1\\ Y_2\\ \vdots\\ Y_N \end{pmatrix} =  \begin{pmatrix} 1&x_1\\ 1&x_2\\ \vdots\\ 1&x_N \end{pmatrix} \begin{pmatrix} \beta_0\\ \beta_1 \end{pmatrix} + \begin{pmatrix} \varepsilon_1\\ \varepsilon_2\\ \vdots\\ \varepsilon_N \end{pmatrix} simply: 𝒀=𝑿𝜷+𝜺 \mathbf{Y}=\mathbf{X}\boldsymbol{\beta}+\boldsymbol{\varepsilon} design matrix 𝑿\mathbf{X} computer take 𝑿\mathbf{X} given solving 𝜷\boldsymbol{\beta} minimizing sum squares residuals 𝜺\boldsymbol{\varepsilon}, maximizing likelihood.
